subject: Welcome to Verity Systems! 🎉
body:
Hi {firstName}!

Welcome to the Verity Systems family! We're SO excited to have you join our Cognitive Wellness Division.

I'm Holly, your HR representative, and I'm here to help make your onboarding as smooth as possible. If you ever have any questions, concerns, or just want to chat, my door is always open! (Metaphorically speaking—I'm usually at my desk.)

A few things to get you started:

1. YOUR WORKSTATION
   Your terminal has been pre-configured with the basic tools you'll need. Take some time to explore! Type 'help' to see available commands.

2. STARTER BONUS
   As a welcome gift, we've added ¢250 to your account! 🎁
   You can use these credits in the Company Store to purchase productivity upgrades for your workstation.

3. YOUR FIRST ASSIGNMENT
   Dr. Reeves will be sending over your first case file shortly. Nothing too complex—just a chance to get familiar with our systems.

4. WELLNESS CHECK-INS
   We care about your mental health! You'll receive periodic wellness assessments. These are completely routine and help us ensure you're thriving in your role.

Remember: What we do here MATTERS. Every adjustment we make improves someone's quality of life. You should feel proud to be part of this team.

Looking forward to seeing great things from you!

Warmly,
Holly Banks
HR Representative
Cognitive Wellness Division

---
Verity Systems Corporation
"Clarity Through Innovation"
